text.p: WinStar Communications Inc and BellSouth Corp said Monday they signed a regionwide interconnect agreement covering nine southern states in which BellSouth provides service.
The states include four major markets - Atlanta, Miami, Memphis and Jacksonville - in which WinStar holds licenses allowing it to provide wireless fiber service, the companies said.
The agrement allows WinStar to provide local telecommunications service to businesses and residential customers in competition with BellSouth.

The agreement provides for WinStar's interconnection at any technically feasible point in the BellSouth system and sets the price each company will pay for completing a phone call on the other's network, the companies said.

It also sets the terms and conditions under which WinStar will be able to buy BellSouth unbundled network elements for use in its own network, and provides for resale of BellSouth services by WinStar to its customers, the companies said.
